sentences.text:
Having apprehension of being arrested in the aforementioned (2 of 3) [CRLMB-2970/2024]
matter, the petitioners have prayed for anticipatory bail on the ground that no case for the alleged offences is made out against them and their incarceration is not warranted.
There are no factors at play in the case at hand that may work against grant of anticipatory bail to the accused-petitioners and they have been made an accused based on conjectures and surmises.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that co-accused persons viz. Mahaveer, Prem Shankar and Udai Ram have already been enlarged on anticipatory bail by this Court vide order dated 14.02.2024 passed in S.B. Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.517/2024 (Mahaveer & Ors. Vs.
State of Rajasthan) and the case of the present petitioner is similar to that of co-accused persons and thus, no fruitful purpose would be served by sending the petitioners behind the bars.

entities.text:
S.B. Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.517/2024 (Mahaveer & Ors. Vs.
State of Rajasthan
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It was prayed that therefore, the petitioners may be grant the benefit of anticipatory bail.

4. Contrary to the submissions of learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application and submitted that the present case is not fit for grant of anticipatory bail.

He is not in a position to dispute the fact that the above named co-accused persons have already been enlarged on anticipatory bail by this Court and the case of the petitioners si not distinguishable from that of co-accused persons.
5. I have considered the submissions made by both the parties and have perused the material available on record.

6. Considering the over all facts and circumstances of the case, it is deemed suitable to grant the benefit of anticipatory bail to the (3 of 3) [CRLMB-2970/2024] petitioners in the present matter on the ground of parity.
7. Accordingly, the instant bail application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

The S.H.O/I.O/Arresting Officer of the concerned Police Station is directed that in the event of arrest of the petitioners in connection with the FIR, details of which have been given in tabular form above,
they shall be released on bail, provided each of them furnishe a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties in the sum of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the S.H.O/I.O/Arresting Officer of the concerned Police Station on the following conditions:-
(i) that the petitioners shall make themselves available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;
(ii) that the petitioners shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the court or any police officer, and (iii) that the petitioners shall not leave India without previous permission of the court.
(FARJAND ALI),J Abhishek Kumar S.No.96 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
